title: Winning the Outer Contest
summary: The Soul Refining Sect searches the outer sect for whoever wrecked the spirit vein, but inner disciple Wang Zhen's soul-search checks never notice Wang Lin. Wang Lin's body is back to the peak of late Nascent Soul, while his Intent is at the level of mid Soul Formation. Liu Mei finds him and warns him about a bracelet she once saw on Hongdie, but he suspects her motives and sends her away. At the bloody outer-disciple contest, which Wang Lin realises exists to harvest souls for the sect, he reaches the final and turns Sima's Death Curse back on him. Grand Elder Wu Daoqi lets him pass, and Wang Zhen leads him into the inner sect's Soul Refining Peak, explaining soul flags, the nine Soul Formation elders and the two Soul Transformation ancestors, including Dun Tian and his Billion Soul Flag. Wang Lin takes a Hundred Soul Flag and a jade slip by force, learns from Xu Yun that the full method is split across three peaks, and breaks into an Ancient Soul Restriction in the main spirit vein.
events: Wang Zhen leads a soul-search sweep of the outer sect; Wang Lin passes unnoticed
Liu Mei visits Wang Lin and warns him about Hongdie's bracelet; he refuses her

He beats Sima's Death Curse in the final and is checked by Grand Elder Wu Daoqi
Wang Zhen explains soul flag ranks, the three peaks, and Ancestor Dun Tian's Billion Soul Flag
Wang Lin takes a Hundred Soul Flag and a jade slip from a senior in the scripture pavilion
Xu Yun explains that the soul flag method is split among three peaks
Wang Lin breaks an Ancient Soul Restriction in the main spirit vein
introduced: Soul Refining, Soul Extraction and God Sealing peaks
cultivation: Wang Lin: peak of late Nascent Soul, with his Intent at mid Soul Formation. Wang Zhen: early Nascent Soul. Sima: peak Core Formation. Wu Daoqi: late Nascent Soul great perfection. Xu Yun: mid Core Formation. The sect has nine Soul Formation elders and two Soul Transformation ancestors.
